Radiobedienteil muß für die Abfrage des: The radio control panel must be switched on to query the button status (except the On button)
Taste < F2 >: Status Tasten RBT: Key  < F2 >: Radio control panel button status
Taste < F5 >: Status Betriebsmode RBT: Key  < F5 >: Radio control panel operating mode status
Taste < F6 >: Status KL R ON/OFF: Key  < F6 >: Terminal R ON/OFF status
Taste < F1 >: RBT Tasten kurz ansteuern: Key < F1 >: Activate radio control panel buttons, short
Taste < F2 >: Bedienteilstatus auf PDO: Key < F2  >: Set control panel status to PD0
Taste < F2 >: Status Klemme R ON setzen: Key < F2  >: Set terminal R status to ON
Taste < F3 >: Bedienteilstatus auf PD1: Key < F3  >: Set control panel status to PD1
Taste < F3 >: Status Klemme R OFF setze: Key < F3  >: Set terminal R status to OFF
Taste < F3 >: Satellit Tasten kurz anste: Key < F3 >: Activate satellite buttons, short
Taste < F4 >: Bedienteilstatus auf KL_R: Key < F4  >: Set control panel status to KL_R_AKTIV (radio control panel must be switched on)
Taste < F5 >: Bedienteilstatus auf KL_R: Key < F5  >: Set control panel status to KL_R_STAND_BY (radio control panel must be switched off)
Taste < F5 >: Bedienteilstatus setzen: Key < F5 >: Set control panel status
Taste < F6 >: Bedienteilstatus auf KL_1: Key < F6  >: Set control panel status to KL_15
Taste < F6 >: Status KL R ON/OFF: Key < F6 >: Terminal R ON/OFF status
Taste < F7 >: Bedienteilstatus auf KL_5: Key < F7  >: Set control panel status to KL_50
kurzes Ansteuern der RBT Tasten: Short activation of the radio control panel buttons
kurzes Ansteuern der Tasten des Satellit: Short activation of the satellite buttons
langes Ansteuern der RBT Tasten: Long activation of the radio control panel buttons
langes Ansteuern der Tasten des Satellit: Long activation of the satellite buttons
